jobs.title: Advocacy & Campaign Manager – Europe
jobs.reason: Two hard disqualifiers apply: a Manager title with an essential 3–5 years' experience in a similar advocacy/campaigns role, and essential proficiency in Italian, which the candidate does not hold. It is also a comms/campaigns specialist role, an area of limited experience. The international-law and human-rights subject matter is genuinely interesting, but the level, language and skills are unmet essentials.

jobs.title: Referendar*in (m/w/d) in Kambodscha
jobs.reason: This is a Wahlstation reserved exclusively for German Rechtsreferendare (legal trainees who have passed the first state law exam and are in legal clerkship), requiring a Diplom-Jurist qualification and an ongoing Referendariat — none of which the candidate holds. It is a legal-qualification gate the candidate fails, so it is ineligible despite the development-policy setting.

jobs.title: Hauptsachbearbeiter (m/w/d) für die Leitung der Gruppe Haushalt im Referat Finanzen, Reisestelle
jobs.reason: This is a leadership role ("Leitung der Gruppe Haushalt") requiring proven relevant professional experience, management/leadership competence, comprehensive knowledge of public budget and grant law, and ERP software skills — none of which the candidate has. It is a finance/administration management post clearly above entry-level and outside the candidate's interest and skill profile.
